what: Layered illustrations (tree leaf layers, tower, signboard) sway once every 2.6s. Each layer goes 0→5°→−2°→0 over 1.5s, with upper layers following .07s later each, like wind passing. Each tree gets a different delay (0, .07, .14, .21s) so the forest ripples

options.[data-fx-part=tier]: Layers to shake (top to bottom) — the user sets the axis with transform-origin (default center of layer box)
options.sp: Delay (s) to use on phone (767px or less)

from.where: index.html · lookbook.html .mj-tree — original LoopClass (is-swing, 1500ms/2600ms) · fusaSwing keyframes
